00111100_00000010_00010010_00110100   // lui $2, 0x1234       // $2 = 12340000;
00110100_01000011_01010110_01111000   // ori $3, $2, 0x5678  // $3 = 12345678;
00111100_00000100_00010001_00100010   // lui $4, 0x1122       // $4 = 11220000;
00110100_10000101_00110011_01000100   // ori $5, $4, 0x3344 // $5 = 11223344;

00000000_01000011_00111000_00100100   // and $7, $2, $3         // $7 = $2 & $3;
00000000_01000011_01000000_00100111   // nor $8, $2,  $3        // $8 = ~($2 | $3);
00100000_00001001_00000000_00000001   // addi $9, $0, 0x0001 // $9 = 0 + 1 = 00000001;
00000000_01000101_01010000_00101011   // sltu $10, $2, $4       // $10 = ($2 < $4) ? 1 : 0  = 0;
00000000_00000010_01011000_01000010   // srl $11, $2, 0x0001  // $11 = $2 >> 0x0001;

10100100_00000011_00000000_00001100   // sh $3, 12($0)    // Mem[0 + 12] <- $3;
10000000_00001100_00000000_00001100   // lb $12, 12($0)  // $12 <- Mem[0 + 12];

00010100_01000011_00000000_00000001   // bne $2, $3, offset=0x0001  // if ($2 != $3) +1
00100000_00001101_00000000_00000001   // addi $13, $0, 0x0001         // 다르면 건너뜀
00100000_00001101_00000000_00110001   // addi $13, $0, 0x31            // 다르면 여기

00000100_01100001_00000000_00000001   // bgez $3, offset=0x0001     // if ($3 >= 0) +1
00100000_00001110_00000000_00110101   // addi $14, $0, 0x0053        // 음수면 여기
00100000_00001110_00000000_01100011   // addi $14, $0, 0x0063        // 0 이상이면 여기

00000001_10000000_11111000_00001001   // jalr $31, $12     // jalr $a($31), $12   // jalr $12
